Build a workforce ready for what’s next
The platform reads real skills signals across roles, work, and learning. Skill requirements stay current and aligned to how the business is actually changing, not how it looked last year.
Learning outcomes continuously update skill profiles and guide what comes next. Readiness, mobility, and progress stay visible, measurable, and easy to act on as priorities shift.
Use skills intelligence to drive learning priorities and validate progress. Apply verified skills directly to workforce decisions.
Align development to real roles, projects, and transformation priorities. Build the skills the business needs now and next.
Run skills, learning, and workforce workflows on one intelligence layer. Keep data consistent across learning, mobility, and planning.
Use AI agents to turn skill gaps into learning and workforce actions. Track progress continuously so execution stays measurable.

Built on the belief that skills are living signals, not static data, 365Talents helps organizations understand how capability evolves over time and use that insight to guide movement, planning, and development. It turns skills into a practical input for workforce decisions, not just something tracked on paper.

They support different needs. Docebo Skills Management helps structure skills to support development by aligning roles, skills, and learning paths. 365Talents goes further by using skills intelligence to support workforce decisions like internal mobility, redeployment, and planning. One supports how people build skills. The other helps organizations apply them.

No. Each platform delivers value on its own. Some organizations start by improving development and learning relevance. Others start with workforce visibility and mobility challenges. Used together, they create a more advanced, skills-driven approach—but there’s no requirement to adopt both at once.

Both platforms are designed to work with your current stack. Docebo integrates with HRIS and content systems to support learning delivery. 365Talents sits across HR, ATS, and learning tools as an intelligence layer—bringing skills data together without replacing systems of record or forcing major architectural change.
HR and business leaders use it to understand readiness and reduce reliance on external hiring.

Most skills platforms treat skills as static data—metadata for learning or inputs for reporting. Docebo and 365Talents treat skills as living intelligence, continuously updated and connected to both development and workforce decisions. The difference isn’t more dashboards. It’s skills that stay current and actually get used.
